title: cloudrift-ai/emmy
summary: Emmy是一个用于在GPU服务器上基准测试和部署优化后的LLM模型的Python工具。它支持从预定义的优化食谱中选择或自定义配置来创建模型。用户可以在不同的GPU类型和配置上运行基准测试，跟踪结果并与社区分享实验。
description: Benchmark and deploy optimized LLM models on GPU servers with vLLM or SGLang. Chose from a list of optimized recipes for popular models or create your own with custom configurations. Run benchmarks across different GPU types and configurations, track results, and share experiments with the community
